content: उत्कण्ठा .²1 Anxiety, uneasiness (in general); यास्यत्यद्य शकुन्तलेति हृदयं संस्पृष्टमुत्कण्ठया <ls>Ś. 4. 5</ls>; अवाप्त˚ <ls>Māl. 2. 12</ls> seized with fright, suddenly startled. .²2 Longing for a beloved person or thing; दृष्टिरधिकं सोत्कण्ठ मुद्वीक्षते <ls>Amaru. 28</ls>. .²3 Regret, sorrow, missing any thing or person; गाढोत्कण्ठा <ls>Māl. 1. 15</ls>; <ls>Me. 85</ls>.
